pages.text: Equipping the $(l)Oathbound Relic$() makes you $(l:oathboundrelics:glossary/remnant_terms#branded)Branded$(). It powers bound curios and higher Titan's Remnant stages, and you need it for the sin weapons.$(br2)It gives both blessings and curses. Values are config defaults.

pages.title: The Covenant
pages.text: $(li)Binds permanently once equipped$(li)Persists through death$(li)Awakens bound relics and Titan's Remnants$(li)Required for late-game forging

$(l)Curses$()$(br)$(li)Frailty: you take extra damage$(li)Provocation: neutral mobs turn hostile$(li)Shattered Plate: armor is less effective$(li)Blood Toll: your first hit every few seconds costs health$(li)Living Ember: fire lasts longer on you$(li)Soul Fracture: when you respawn, part of your soul is left behind; go back for it$(li)Wakeful Doom: you can't sleep, except near a Rite of Repose
$(l)Blessings$()$(br)$(li)Bonus Looting$(li)Bonus Fortune$(li)Much more XP from kills$(li)Higher enchanting power$(li)Bonus attack speed$(li)Absorption at low health
